notes: New in Claude Code v2.1.251. Cannot block -- the model has already changed. Plain-text stdout on exit 0, or additionalContext from JSON output, is delivered to Claude with the next request after the switch. additionalContext is NESTED under hookSpecificOutput (with hookEventName set), not top level: the Decision control table names the path 'hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext' for SessionStart, SubagentStart and PostModelSwitch together, and the 'Add context for Claude' section that governs this event says to return it inside hookSpecificOutput. The weaker per-event wording ('in addition to the JSON output fields available to all hooks') is the same phrasing SessionStart and SubagentStart use, so it does not distinguish top level from nested. A hook emitting additionalContext at the top level here would have it silently dropped. If the hook hasn't finished within five seconds after the next prompt is sent, the output is attached to the following request instead; multiple switches before the next request deliver only the last switch's output. Runs for requested switches, automatic model fallback, opusplan entering/leaving plan mode, and session-resume restore -- but NOT for a one-turn fallback-chain substitution. Input: same fields as PreModelSwitch with hook_event_name 'PostModelSwitch' and two more source values: 'auto' (automatic fallback or other self-made change; requested_model is null) and 'resume' (requested_model is the saved model setting restored).
